name: nusajs-monorepo
description: Workspace for the NusaJS web framework.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nusajs/core build && pnpm --filter @nusajs/compiler build && pnpm --filter @nusajs/renderer-preact build && pnpm --filter @nusajs/adapter-node build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && tsc --build --force tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @nusajs/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @nusajs/compiler typecheck && pnpm --filter @nusajs/renderer-preact typecheck && pnpm --filter @nusajs/adapter-node typecheck
scripts.deps:check: pnpm run deps:audit && pnpm run deps:licenses
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run boundaries:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run deps:check
